steps.title: Die Konfiguration der Autorin nimmt die Schlüssel auf: Prüfer in „pruefer“, improves Systemschlüssel in „improve“
steps.command:
python3 -c 'import json,shutil,os; c=json.load(open("cockpit.config.json")); shutil.copy("/mnt/c/dev/git-repos/kton-cockpit/acceptance/raute-zwei-backends/.work/review/pruefer.pub","registry/keys/pruefer-claims.pub"); c["trust"]["tiers"]["pruefer"]=["registry/keys/pruefer-claims.pub"]; p="/mnt/c/dev/git-repos/kton-cockpit/acceptance/raute-zwei-backends/results/review-improve-claims/improve-system.pub"
if os.path.exists(p): shutil.copy(p,"registry/keys/improve-system.pub"); c["trust"]["tiers"]["improve"]=["registry/keys/improve-system.pub"]
json.dump(c,open("cockpit.config.json","w"),indent=2); print(json.dumps(c["trust"]["tiers"]))'
